title: Add Redis password to BullMQ Worker connection config
description: Fix Redis connection in QueueProcessor by adding the missing password field to the Worker connection configuration
approach: The root cause is twofold: (1) EnvService.redisConfig has password hardcoded as undefined instead of reading from REDIS_PASSWORD env var, and (2) QueueProcessor Worker connection config doesn't include the password field. Fix both locations to ensure Redis authentication works correctly.

tasks.title: Fix redisConfig getter to read REDIS_PASSWORD from environment
tasks.description: Update the redisConfig getter to read the password from REDIS_PASSWORD environment variable instead of hardcoding undefined
implementation: Locate the redisConfig getter at line 112-120
Change line 117 from `password: undefined,` to `password: this.get<string | undefined>('REDIS_PASSWORD', { infer: true }),`
Verify the change maintains type safety with string | undefined
acceptance_criteria: redisConfig.password reads from REDIS_PASSWORD env var
Existing code using redisConfig continues to work
verification: Verify env.schema.ts includes REDIS_PASSWORD (or add if missing)
Test with REDIS_PASSWORD set and unset

tasks.title: Add password field to QueueProcessor Worker connection config

implementation: Locate the Worker instantiation at lines 188-197

verification: Test Worker initialization with Redis password configured
